title: SCM Media Management Specification
scope: Owner-approved scope addition: media handling, previously out of scope, is now partially in scope — images only, managed through a dedicated media folder.

config.description: scm-config.json gains an optional top-level property: media_dir
rules: Must be a relative path (same rules as projects_dir / content_dir: no absolute paths, no ..).
Resolved against the target project checkout — media files live in the target website repository so they are versioned and published with it.

backend_api.security: All endpoints operate strictly inside <checkout>/<media_dir> (traversal-proof; names are validated single path components with an image extension allow-list: png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp, svg, avif, ico, bmp).

endpoints.response: { media_dir, files: [{ name, size, url, modified }] }

endpoints.purpose: serve the raw file (correct image content-type)
upload (raw bytes body, ≤20 MB, dedup name-2.ext…)

notes: url in listings is the site-relative URL (/<media_dir>/<name>, normalized without ./ and trailing slash) — this is what content embeds and what 'copy link' puts on the clipboard.
The former /assets upload endpoint is superseded by POST …/media; uploads now land in media_dir instead of the hardcoded public/images.

Publishing stages media_dir (when present) in addition to the content directory (and the legacy public/images folder for backwards compatibility), so uploaded media is committed and pushed with the content.
Non-image files inside media_dir are ignored by listings (previews require images); they are never deleted or moved by SCM.

navigation.description: The sidebar gains a Media button above the Content category (folder-with-image icon). Clicking it switches the canvas to the media manager view. Clicking a content file or Settings switches away, as today.

media_manager_view.upload_button: At the top (file picker; multiple files allowed; each upload goes through the POST endpoint; dedup rules apply).

view_mode_toggle.description: Four modes, persisted in localStorage under key 'scm:media-view':

modes.label: List with minimal previews (tiny thumbnail, row-oriented)

item_actions: Rename (inline prompt; renaming onto an existing name is rejected with the server's 409)

viewer_lightbox.description: Clicking an item opens a full-screen viewer:
features: Large centered preview over a dimmed backdrop.
Left/right arrow buttons navigate to the previous/next media item (wrapping); the keyboard arrow keys do the same.
× button and Esc close; swipe gestures: left/right navigate, up/down close.
The bottom bar repeats rename / copy link / delete for the open item.
Navigation order follows the current list order.
Closing the viewer after rename/delete refreshes the grid.

rich_editor_integration.description: The ProseMirror 'insert image (upload)' button uploads into media_dir through the same endpoint and embeds the returned site-relative URL. The 'copy link' URL matches what the editor embeds, so pasted links resolve.

acceptance_criteria: media_dir defaults to ./public/media/ and is validated when present.
Uploads land in <checkout>/<media_dir> with dedup and are published.
The sidebar Media button opens the manager; the four view modes work and persist across reloads.
Copy link puts the site-relative URL on the clipboard.
Rename rejects duplicates (409 surfaced inline); delete removes the file.
The viewer opens on click, navigates with arrows/keys/swipe, closes with ×/Esc/down-swipe, and offers rename/copy link/delete.
Closing the viewer after rename or delete refreshes the grid.
